summary.text: Dinah Sykes is a Democratic member of the Kansas Senate representing District 21 (Johnson County), and the Legislature's member page lists service in the Senate since 2017.
Dinah Sykes is listed as the ranking minority member of the Education Committee.

paragraphs.text: Dinah Sykes is listed as a member of the Education Committee.
The page names Jeffrey Sykes as Dinah Sykes's spouse.
